resources.string: Debugging can manage the TV system, not just OpenTV. Only authorize it when you started setup.
OpenTV is already your default desktop. Additional Home Guard access is not needed.
On FFALCON TVs, open Settings → About → Device information.\nPress ↑ Up, ↓ Down, ← Left, → Right, then enable ADB debugging. Return here and choose Enabled, continue.
Connecting to TV debugging. The system may ask for authorization to manage the TV, not just OpenTV. Desktop permissions are not changed yet.
The system debugging authorization can manage the TV, not just OpenTV. Choose Allow only if you started this check. Setup will continue automatically.

Debugging can manage the system, not just OpenTV. This guide changes only this app. System settings restore Home Guard; accessibility observes windows and Home; overlays allow background launch. Notification access can expose notification content, but OpenTV does not read it.
You previously enabled keeping debugging on. Granting access may resume that feature without changing your existing choice.
Enabling the following feature. Please wait.
Cancel stops the remaining setup. Settings already enabled will stay enabled.
Some items are not ready. Settings already enabled are retained. Check again. Details have been recorded in the debugging log.
This TV uses a debugging connection that is not supported yet. You can still use the desktop. No permissions were changed by this check.
Debugging authorization has not arrived. Make sure ADB is enabled and choose Allow in the system dialog, then check again.
Could not connect to TV debugging. Make sure ADB is enabled, then check again. Details have been recorded in the debugging log.
Connected to the TV, but reading settings failed. You do not need to toggle ADB. Check again. Details have been recorded in the debugging log.
Allow the desktop to open in the background
